long_description: HPSO (Healthcare Providers Service Organization) has been a leading provider of professional liability insurance for healthcare professionals since 1983. They cover over 20 different healthcare professions including mental health counselors, marriage and family therapists, social workers, psychologists, and psychiatric nurses. HPSO offers both individual and group coverage options with limits up to $3M per occurrence. Policies include coverage for defense costs, license protection, personal liability, and assault coverage. HPSO provides occurrence-based policies through CNA, an A-rated carrier with over 100 years of insurance experience. The online application process provides instant quotes and coverage. HPSO is known for their extensive risk management resources, including free CE courses, legal advice hotlines, and detailed claims data reports that help practitioners understand common liability risks in their profession.
best_for: Those wanting extensive risk management resources
not_for: Large health systems needing enterprise coverage

pricing.notes: Premiums vary by profession, hours worked, coverage limits, and state. Online quotes available. Mental health professionals typically pay $200-500/year.

compliance.notes: Insurance provider - HIPAA not applicable. Policies underwritten by CNA, an A-rated carrier with over 100 years experience.

faqs.a: HPSO stands for Healthcare Providers Service Organization. They've been providing professional liability insurance to healthcare professionals since 1983.
HPSO policies are underwritten by CNA, an A-rated insurance carrier with over 100 years of experience in healthcare liability coverage.

faqs.q: Does HPSO cover mental health professionals?
faqs.a: Yes, HPSO covers mental health counselors, marriage and family therapists, social workers, psychologists, psychiatric nurses, and other behavioral health professionals.

faqs.q: How much does HPSO insurance cost for therapists?
faqs.a: HPSO premiums for mental health professionals typically range from $200-500/year for full-time practitioners with $1M/$3M coverage, varying by profession and state.

company_info.notes: HPSO is part of Aon Affinity and provides coverage underwritten by CNA. They cover over 20 healthcare professions and have extensive risk management resources.
